set -euo pipefail
VENV=$(mktemp -d /tmp/photomap-deps-publish-venv-XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$VENV"; ./scripts/devctl.sh stop >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
python3 -m venv "$VENV"
"$VENV/bin/python" -m pip install -q -r backend/requirements.txt
cd frontend
npm audit --audit-level=moderate
npm run format:check
npm run lint
npm run knip
npm test
npm run build
npx playwright install chromium
PYTHON="$VENV/bin/python" npm run test:e2e -- --project=chromium e2e/smoke
cd ..
git diff --check
changed=$(git diff --name-only | sort)
test "$changed" = $'frontend/package-lock.json\nfrontend/package.json'
